purpose: Independent evidence ledger for the TWC 2026 Day-3 deciders and the unresolved low-tier fixtures. Every entry was read by this session through the listed URL; read_utc is the time of that read. Entries marked status=unverified could not be re-read and are NOT used as inputs.

entries.topic: Aurora vs 9z kickoff + listing (Day 3 Group A decider)
entries.what_it_shows: HLTV match page: Thunderpick World Championship 2026, Best of 3 (LAN), '* Group A decider match', start shown as 10:00 on 16 Oct; countdown 6h 39m 35s at read time, which matches a 14:00 UTC start (HLTV display is UTC-4 on this fetch path, as recorded by earlier sessions).

entries.topic: Aurora vs 9z HLTV analytics: bookmaker favourite + head-to-head
entries.what_it_shows: 'Aurora is the bookmaker favorite with the best odds'; 'Aurora has won 3 out of the last 5 matches'; 'Aurora played 2 matches against 9z in the past 30 days, and lost the latest'; '9z played 2 matches against Aurora in the past 30 days, and won the latest'; HLTV ranks Aurora #6 and 9z #17. HLTV handicap/correct-score prices on the same page are a different market and are not used.
entries.used_for: head-to-head flag (9z won latest meeting); ranks context

entries.topic: Aurora vs 9z HLTV betting widget 'Pick a winner'
entries.what_it_shows: A fan 'Pick a winner' poll showing 82.1% / 17.9% (ordering in the captured text is ambiguous). It is community sentiment, not a betting price.
entries.used_for: NOT used as a probability (crowd sentiment, same class as HotSpawn pick %)

entries.what_it_shows: HLTV news dated 14-10-2026: '9z beat Aurora 2-0 to kick off TWC 2026'. The HLTV match page 2399384 (9z vs Aurora) is the same series.

entries.topic: Aurora 2-0 Ninjas in Pyjamas (Day 2) and Falcons 2-1 9z (Day 2)
entries.what_it_shows: HLTV news dated 15-10-2026: Ninjas in Pyjamas lost 0-2 to Aurora in Group A elimination. Falcons 2-1 9z is recorded in HLTV news 45728 (Falcons secure playoff berth, 15-10-2026 16:34), which also lists Aurora vs 9z for 16/10/2026 16:00.
entries.used_for: Day-2 results; both teams' match load (9z 3 maps on Day 2, Aurora 2 maps)

entries.topic: Day-2 results for Group B (BetBoom 2-1 PARIVISION; FURIA 2-1 Legacy)
entries.what_it_shows: Field Level Media wire: 'Falcons defeated 9z Team 2-1 in the Group A winners match, while FURIA rallied past Legacy 2-1 in Group B. Aurora swept Ninjas in Pyjamas 2-0 in the Group A elimination match, and BetBoom eliminated PARIVISION with a 2-1 victory in Group B.' Corroborated by HLTV team page https://www.hltv.org/team/12394/betboom (15/10/2026 BETBOOM 2:1 PARIVISION).

entries.topic: Aurora rebuild: kyxsan IGL, Jimpphat, coach ash (July 2026)
entries.what_it_shows: Strafe, dated Wednesday 8 July 2026: Aurora welcomes kyxsan as IGL, after Jimpphat (from MOUZ) and coach ashhh arrived two days earlier; the roster is 'now complete' for the second half of 2026.
entries.used_for: Aurora onboarding flag (roster change / new IGL, about three months before Day 3)

entries.topic: Aurora coach interview: rebuild still developing (Aug 2026)
entries.what_it_shows: Article (states it summarises an HLTV interview published 12 Aug 2026): ash says the team's practice form is promising but official-match consistency is 'still developing'; 'No additional roster change was announced in the interview.'
entries.used_for: Onboarding flag strength; confirms no further roster change as of Aug 2026

entries.topic: Search for an October 2026 Aurora roster change
entries.what_it_shows: HotSpawn roster-change news page (undated in capture) and the HLTV/cs2news/strafe articles above describe only the summer 2026 rebuild. No October 2026 Aurora roster change was found in any source read in this session. The brief's 'recent roster change' is therefore the July 2026 rebuild, about three months old.
entries.used_for: Flag: the 'recent change' premise is not confirmed as an October event

entries.topic: Legacy roster: try joins, n1ssim reinstated (summer 2026)
entries.what_it_shows: HLTV rostermania tracker (July 2026 reports): Santino 'try' Rigal was expected to move from Imperial to Legacy after a recall ('all but confirms', 9-10 Jul); n1ssim reinstated 10/07. HLTV Legacy vs Falcons EWC match page (2026-08-20) lists the lineup arT, dumau, latto, n1ssim, try, so the move is confirmed by August.
entries.used_for: Legacy onboarding flag (new player 'try' in summer 2026)

entries.what_it_shows: HLTV BETBOOM team page lists the TWC Day-1/Day-2 matches with the players Boombl4, d1Ledez, Magnojez, S1ren, zorte (match scorecards in HLTV news 45723 and the Miami Herald wire). No roster change was found in the sources read.
Russian betting-analysis preview for Aurora vs 9z on 16 Oct 2026 quotes P1 Aurora 1.38 and P2 9z 2.7 (bookmaker not named in the captured text).
